versions.name: GIGA Batteries
versions.text: Turn start: If there's no ally GIGA Queen, gain a counter to summon one and add a Detachable Hands to your hand. If this already has a counter, add 2 Detachable Hands instead. At 2 counters, disable this artifact.

versions.name: GIGA Batteries
versions.text: You are Immune to Fatigue. Turn start: If there's no ally GIGA Queen, gain a counter to summon one and add Detachable Hands to your hand, or two if this has a counter. At 2 counters disable this artifact.

versions.name: Imminent Showdown
versions.text: Starts with 3 counters. After an ally GIGA Queen dies, spend a counter to return it to your deck with +2/+2/+2 base stats. After an ally GIGA Queen dies at 8 counters, add Detachable Hands to your hand and disable this.
versions.note: Renamed from GIGA Batteries. Miraheze: Now gives each copy of GIGA Queen +1/+2/+2 base stats instead of +2/+2/+2 base stats.
